task: Plan a five-minute class presentation about renewable energy in three parts and write a short text for each part. The presentation is on the next Friday, so one step of the plan must find the real date of that Friday and give a rehearsal schedule with real dates. The plan has at most five steps.

en.title: Plan and execute: a longer plan, and the real date from the clock
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
A stronger planner writes a longer plan, and the executor works through every step.

**What it teaches**

The quality of the whole run depends on the plan. The executor can call a tool: here the clock, because a model does not know what day it is.

**What to watch**

Whether the executor asks the clock for the date, and how the rehearsal dates follow from it.

Read more: [Plan and execute](#/learn/plan-and-execute)

cs.title: Plánuj a proveď: delší plán a skutečné datum z hodin
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Silnější plánovač napíše delší plán a vykonavatel projde každý krok.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Kvalita celého běhu závisí na plánu. Vykonavatel může zavolat nástroj: tady hodiny, protože model neví, jaký je den.

**Na co se dívat**

Zda vykonavatel požádá hodiny o datum a jak z něj plynou termíny zkoušek.

Více si přečtěte: [Plánuj a proveď](#/learn/plan-and-execute)
